android_reference.semantics: Hides expand/close overlay views and the modern-4 action group when the overlay setting is available.

class_local_inherited_hooks.scope: Only controls associated with a verified persistent miniplayer owner and attached to that owner.contentView. Global UIView implementation is unchanged.

native_visibility: Capture native hidden state on binding; update it on native setters; retain weak owner and prevent nested patched setters from overwriting the baseline. Disabling the feature restores the native state on layout. Backgrounds restore native alpha times the existing opacity preference.

remaining_miniplayer_scope.type_variants: Android legacy phone/tablet/modern1-5 types do not map to the single verified iOS persistent-controls hierarchy; the existing classic experiment toggle does not reproduce these variants.
remaining_miniplayer_scope.hide_rewind_forward: The verified iOS action group creates play/pause, replay/next and MDX autoplay-dismiss controls; no distinct rewind/forward pair was identified in this hierarchy.
remaining_miniplayer_scope.disable_on_collapse: Native activateMiniBar also handles fetch/activation lifecycle and can clear its player; collapse-only termination needs a verified user-collapse boundary and ordinary/ad/Cast ownership. Hooking all activations would implement different behavior.
remaining_miniplayer_scope.title_channel_suppression: The mapped iOS badge API is for messages/Premium, not title/channel labels; no verified title/channel target exists in this hierarchy.
